ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 40:60 distribution of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, high-intensity white contiguous regions occupy the distal halves of the left and right lobes. These are separated by a broad, low-intensity black vertical band extending from the peduncle to the notch. Dense black mottling and stippling are concentrated at the inferior-medial borders of the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 38 degrees with a vertical depth extending roughly 12% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 2-8 pixels, most prominent on the lateral third of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the lateral trailing edge transitioning into a gentle S-curve concavity as it approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Fine, circular low-intensity clusters (stippling) localized primarily along the lower boundaries of the white pigmentation zones on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jaggedness and minor tissue loss at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
